labLogic.repeat_or_confirm_strategy: Use the condition-specific conventional pathway; do not serially screen wellness patients.
labLogic.interpretation_text: Never interpret as proof of spike persistence, microclots, or vaccine causation.

labLogic.purpose: Prevent unvalidated mechanism assays from becoming diagnostic or treatment triggers.
labLogic.trigger_criteria: A commercial spike-persistence, cell-free mRNA, microclot, transcriptomic, or similar assay is proposed
labLogic.supports_when: No automatic supporting effect.
labLogic.weakens_when: Absence of a validated, clinically accepted assay weakens certainty and blocks treatment escalation.
labLogic.critical_or_escalation_rule: Do not activate a drug, peptide, anticoagulant, antiparasitic, oncology, or procedure protocol from the result.
labLogic.confounders: Analytical validity, clinical validity, specimen, timing, independent replication, reference population, and alternative causes
labLogic.repeat_or_confirm_strategy: Require IRB/research governance or an accepted clinical pathway before use.
labLogic.interpretation_text: Display as experimental/unknown and preserve the original report without converting it into a diagnosis.

protocolTemplate.name: Post-vaccination symptom evaluation
protocolTemplate.goal: Document the timeline, screen urgent complications, evaluate alternative causes, and create a reviewed monitoring/referral plan without assigning causation from timing alone.
protocolTemplate.phase_summary: Triage -> verified timeline and records -> conventional differential -> focused testing/referral -> monitored recovery plan -> adverse-event documentation
protocolTemplate.required_baseline_data: Exact vaccine record; symptom baseline and timeline; infections; medications/supplements; vitals; prior evaluations and original results
protocolTemplate.monitoring_cadence: At each clinical change and at practitioner-defined follow-up
protocolTemplate.success_criteria: Urgent conditions addressed; alternative causes evaluated; function and symptoms tracked with objective measures; plan is reviewed and understood
protocolTemplate.stop_criteria: Any acute red flag, worsening function, serious adverse effect, or unsupported mechanism-based escalation

protocolSteps.instructions: Screen current cardiopulmonary, neurologic, thrombotic, allergic, bleeding, and systemic red flags before continuing.
protocolSteps.monitoring: Symptoms, vitals, disposition
protocolSteps.conditional_logic: Any red flag -> urgent/emergency pathway
protocolSteps.adjustment_logic: No wellness adjustment during acute triage
protocolSteps.stop_criteria: Any red flag or inability to assess safely
protocolSteps.patient_facing_text: We will first check whether any symptom needs urgent in-person care.

protocolSteps.instructions: Record exact product, dose, date, onset, progression, baseline symptoms, infections, medication changes, and prior evaluations.
protocolSteps.duration: One assessment; update as records arrive
protocolSteps.monitoring: Source completeness and conflicts
protocolSteps.conditional_logic: Missing records -> request source; conflicts -> label unresolved
protocolSteps.adjustment_logic: Do not infer causation from temporal proximity
protocolSteps.stop_criteria: New red flag or material contradiction
protocolSteps.patient_facing_text: We will build a precise timeline and compare it with your health before the event.

protocolSteps.instructions: Evaluate established vaccine adverse events and unrelated infectious, cardiopulmonary, neurologic, endocrine, hematologic, medication, sleep, mood, and other causes.
protocolSteps.duration: One assessment; revise when data change
protocolSteps.monitoring: Evidence for, against, missing, and conflicting
protocolSteps.conditional_logic: Urgent hypothesis stays pinned; speculative mechanism remains non-diagnostic
protocolSteps.adjustment_logic: Update only through a reviewed evaluation version
protocolSteps.stop_criteria: Unsafe attribution or suppression of an urgent alternative
protocolSteps.patient_facing_text: Several causes can produce similar symptoms, so the plan keeps alternatives visible.

protocolSteps.instructions: Order or request only clinician-directed tests that answer a defined differential question; preserve original reports.
protocolSteps.monitoring: Result provenance and effect on hypotheses
protocolSteps.prerequisites: Defined clinical question and ordering authority
protocolSteps.conditional_logic: Unvalidated mechanism assay -> experimental label and no treatment activation
protocolSteps.adjustment_logic: Repeat only when a result will change management
protocolSteps.stop_criteria: Testing would delay urgent care or create unsupported escalation
protocolSteps.patient_facing_text: Testing is selected to answer a specific clinical question, not to confirm a preselected story.

protocolSteps.instructions: Create a reviewed symptom, function, referral, and monitoring plan; route drugs, peptides, procedures, and bleeding-risk products through their safety gates.
protocolSteps.monitoring: Function, symptoms, adverse effects, adherence
protocolSteps.prerequisites: Practitioner review and informed patient discussion
protocolSteps.conditional_logic: No auto-sign, auto-order, or automatic protocol activation
protocolSteps.adjustment_logic: Start the least burdensome safe intervention and reassess
protocolSteps.stop_criteria: Adverse effect, worsening, or no benefit
protocolSteps.patient_facing_text: Your plan will focus on safety, function, and measurable progress.

protocolSteps.instructions: Offer assistance documenting a suspected adverse event in the appropriate surveillance system and retain the submission status separately from diagnosis.
protocolSteps.monitoring: Report submitted or declined
protocolSteps.conditional_logic: Report status has no diagnostic effect
protocolSteps.adjustment_logic: Correct factual errors without rewriting the original report
protocolSteps.stop_criteria: Patient declines or reporting is outside jurisdiction
protocolSteps.patient_facing_text: A safety report helps surveillance but does not by itself prove what caused the event.

safetyRules.plain_language_expression: If a symptom follows vaccination, infection, supplement use, or another exposure, timing alone must not be presented as proof of causation.
safetyRules.required_data: Event timeline; baseline symptoms; infections; medications; objective findings; alternative explanations
safetyRules.action_when_triggered: Use neutral temporal language, retain alternative causes, and require practitioner review before any causal statement.
safetyRules.applies_to_intervention_or_product: All post-exposure pathways and patient-facing content

safetyRules.plain_language_expression: Current chest pain, severe dyspnea, syncope, focal neurologic deficit, severe unusual headache, unilateral swelling, heavy bleeding, anaphylaxis, or rapidly progressive illness is reported.
safetyRules.required_data: Current symptoms; vitals; pregnancy; anticoagulants; timing
safetyRules.action_when_triggered: Stop the wellness workflow and direct emergency or urgent in-person evaluation according to the symptom.

safetyRules.plain_language_expression: A spike-persistence, cell-free mRNA, microclot, transcriptomic, or other nonvalidated mechanism assay is proposed as diagnostic or treatment-confirming.
safetyRules.required_data: Exact assay; laboratory; validation; specimen; population; clinical question; accepted guideline
safetyRules.action_when_triggered: Label experimental/unknown, preserve the source, and block diagnosis or protocol activation from the result.

safetyRules.plain_language_expression: A protocol contains BPC-157, TB-500, MOTS-c, Epitalon, Semax, Selank, Dihexa, Humanin, GHK-Cu, thymosin products, LL-37, or another unapproved/research peptide.
safetyRules.required_data: Exact substance; formulation; source; approval status; prescriber; indication; informed consent; monitoring
safetyRules.action_when_triggered: Block automatic recommendation, commerce, patient activation, and AI dosing. Permit only a separately governed research/prescriber workflow when lawful.

safetyRules.plain_language_expression: A protocol contains rapamycin, naltrexone, methylene blue, ivermectin, fenbendazole, retatrutide, EDTA, or another prescription/investigational drug.
safetyRules.required_data: Exact drug; indication; approval status; prescriber; contraindications; interactions; monitoring; pharmacy/source
safetyRules.action_when_triggered: Block automatic recommendation and dosing; route to an authorized prescriber and the drug-specific workflow.

safetyRules.plain_language_expression: Nattokinase, lumbrokinase, high-dose omega-3, aspirin-like products, or fibrinolytic stacks are proposed with anticoagulants, antiplatelets, bleeding history, surgery, pregnancy, or active bleeding.
safetyRules.required_data: Medication list; supplement list; bleeding history; surgery/procedure date; pregnancy; liver/kidney status
safetyRules.action_when_triggered: Block until clinician and interaction review; provide urgent instructions for active major bleeding or acute clot symptoms.
safetyRules.applies_to_intervention_or_product: Fibrinolytic, anticoagulant, antiplatelet, and high-dose omega-3 interventions
